newsitem.title: USA: Police confirm cult members died in mass suicide.
newsitem.headline: Police confirm cult members died in mass suicide.

text.p: Police investigating the deaths of 39 cult members in California confirmed on Thursday that the victims died in a mass suicide.
Officials said the 21 women and 18 men were between the ages of 20 and 72 and were dressed in similar outfits, almost as if they were wearing uniforms.
Police said the victims were all members of a cult called "Heaven's Gate."

Dr Brian Blackbourne, the medical examiner for San Diego County, said it appeared that the suicides were carried out in three groups. The second group cleaned up after the first group and the third cleaned up after the second. The last two victims were found with plastic bags on their heads.
He said two of the victims were black and the rest were white or Hispanic.
All the victims had some form of identification on them.
